answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own bridge record, and its own share of the ferrous quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 2 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. The lagoon ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 3030 identities would post 934 proofs and burn roughly 42 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
